Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players have made their way out to the middle. Max O'Dowd and Stephan Myburgh will open the batting for Netherlands. Lockie Ferguson will begin the proceedings with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

New Zealand, on the other hand will be very disappointed with their performance with the blade. After scoring 200 runs in their previous two T20Is, they were struggling to get going here. Martin Guptill got some runs under his belt and kept the scoreboard ticking. However, a cameo from James Neesham and Ish Sodhi at the backend took them close to 150. They have the bowling firepower to defend this but it will be interesting to see how they approach this one. Stay tuned for the second essay!

This has been an excellent bowling effort by Netherlands. They have restricted the Kiwis to under 150. Scott Edwards will be the happier captain, especially after losing the toss! They were very solid in the field and took wickets at regular intervals and didn't let the Kiwi batters to settle in. Logan van Beek and Shariz Ahmad were the bowlers who grabbed two wickets each. Overall it was a great effort and if they bat well they can chase down this total with ease!

Bye! Swing and a miss! A shorter ball, slower in pace, wide of off. Mitchell Santner looks to slash this one but he misses. He scampers across to the other end to steal a bye! New Zealand end at 148 for 7!
Lockie Ferguson is the new man out there but he will be at the non-striker's end for the last ball.

OUT! TAKEN! Ish Sodhi's important cameo comes to an end! Logan van Beek bangs it short, outside off. Ish Sodhi goes for the pull but the ball goes off his top edge and flies high towards short fine leg. Teja Nidamanuru keeps his eys on the ball and pouches it safely!
Commentary.Howout: c Teja Nidamanuru b Logan van Beek

Commentary.Commentary: Takes the pace off this one, serves a length ball, wide of off. Mitchell Santner cuts it towards short third man for a single.
A length delivery, outside off. Ish Sodhi pulls it firmly but he finds the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Only a single.
Swing and a miss! A fuller ball, slower in pace, and outside off. Ish Sodhi swings his bat at it but he misses.
On a length, outside off. Mitchell Santner pushes it towards long on for a single.

SIX! Ish Sodhi is playing quite a cameo here! He is expecting a short ball and this one lands on middle and angling down leg. Ish Sodhi rocks back and pulls this over deep backward square leg for a biggie! Very useful runs here for New Zealand! 20 runs from the penultimate over.
FOUR! Thumps this one away! Clayton Floyd goe short this time and outside off, Ish Sodhi is down the wicket in a flash as he pulls the ball towards deep mid-wicket for four more valuable runs.
Ouch! The six from Ish Sodhi has gone on to hit a small kid in the crowd on his head! He is being assisted by the physio immediately! Hope is doing fine.
SIX! This has been top-edged for a maximum! Clayton Floyd flights this full on middle, Ish Sodhi looks to heave this leg side and gets a thick edge that flies high over deep square leg for six runs.
This is short and wide outside off, Mitchell Santner slashes at the ball and gets an edge towards short third man for a run.
This is full and outside off, Mitchell Santner shimmies down the wicket and lofts the ball towards wide long on for a couple of runs. Some good combination fielding by the players in the deep.
Clayton Floyd serves this short and in line with the stumps, Ish Sodhi charges down the wicket and mistimes the ball towards deep square leg for a single.
Swing and a miss! Wide of off, fuller ball. Mitchell Santner looks to go over cover but he misses.
Slightly short, outside off. Ish Sodhi hangs back and punches it off the back foot towards deep cover for a single.
Slower through the air now, full and outside off. Ish Sodhi drives it towards cover.
Back of a length now, down the leg side. Ish Sodhi swivels and pulls it to the fielder at short fine leg.
Tosses this one up, a low full toss, around middle and leg. Mitchell Santner knocks it towards long on for a single.
A shorter ball, outside off. Mitchell Santner pushes it towards cover. No run there!
Ish Sodhi is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Logan van Beek has the last laugh as he sends James Neesham back in the hut. This is a low full toss on off, James Neesham heaves it hard towards the deep mid-wicket region. Bas de Leede there judges the ball really well and times his jump to perfection to take a stunning catch. James Neesham was looking good and Netherlands will be happy to get rid of him.
Commentary.Howout: c Bas de Leede b Logan van Beek

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Classy from Neesham. This a fuller one again and on middle and leg, James Neesham just holds his position and flicks it over the deep square leg fence for a maximum. This is turning out to be an expensive over.
WIDE! This is full and again way outside off. Wided.
This is full and outside off, James Neesham reaches for it and slices it uppishly towards deep point for a brace.
Goes for the yorker on off but bowls this way outside off. It is called a wide.
SIX! BANG! James Neesham is getting into his groove. This is full and around middle and off, in the slot too. James Neesham smokes it over the wide long on fence for a biggie.
FOUR! THUMPED! This is short and on leg, James Neesham thumps it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary. They need a lot more of those.
In the blockhole and on off, James Neesham digs it towards the vacant mid-wicket region for couple of runs.
Serves this full on the pads, James Neesham clips this towards mid-wicket for a run and keeps strike. End of the good over. Just 5 runs from it.
Angles this into the stumps from outside off, James Neesham flicks this towards deep square leg and they run well to complete two runs.
This is short and wide outside off, Mitchell Santner rocks back and slashes it towards deep-point for a single.
Flighted full on middle, James Neesham knocks this down to long on for a run.
Loopy full toss on off stump, James Neesham goes for the reverse sweep and finds the fine third man fielder.
Tom Cooper begins with a short delivery outside off, James Neesham cuts this straight to backward point.
Mitchell Santner comes out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Shariz Ahmad strikes once again! He sends back Glenn Phillips this time! A wicket at a good time for Netherlands! They have not let New Zealand get away with any partnerships here! New Zealand have now lost half their side. Coming to the ball - Nicely tossed up Shariz Ahmad, serves it full, around middle. Glenn Phillips looks to drive this one but ends up chipping back to the bowler. Shariz Ahmad jumps and takes a good catch above his head.
Shorter one this time, flatter ball, outside off. Glenn Phillips pushes it off the back foot towards deep cover for a brace.
Tosses this one up, fuller ball, around middle. Glenn Phillips pushes it back to the bowler.
Full in length, outside off. James Neesham leans forward and drives it through cover. Only a single.
Swing and a miss! Tosses it up again, outside off, fuller one. James Neesham once again goes on his knee and looks to sweep this but he misses.
A huge shout for LBW, but turned down! A loopy ball, slower through the air, outside off. James Neesham gets down on his knee and tries to sweep this one but he misses and gets hit on his pads.
Another length delivery, darting it on the pads. James Neesham flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

Angling in this time, on a length, around middle and leg. James Neesham works it away towards deep square leg. They run the first one fast and a fumble by a fielder there allows them to come back for the second!
FOUR! James Neesham gets off the mark in style! An overpitched delivery, around off. James Neesham shows the full face of the bat and drives it past the diving fielder at mid off for a boundary.
James Neesham walks out to bat at number 6.

OUT! CAUGHT! Martin Guptill departs after playing a solid knock. A slower ball, on a length and on off, Martin Guptill goes for the heave over backward square leg but is through his shot early. He only manages to scoop the ball high in the air and Tim Pringle in the deep settles under it and takes a nice catch. Netherlands are delighted as the set Martin Guptill goes back to the hut. This will surely make a difference to the total.
Commentary.Howout: c Tim Pringle b Ryan Klein

Commentary.Commentary: This is short and on off, Martin Guptill pulls it of his inner hald wide of deep square leg for a brace.

Quick single! This is on a yorker length and on middle, Glenn Phillips digs it towards short mid on. Thr fielder there has a shy at the non-striker's end and hits the target. But Glenn Phillips makes his ground and completes the run.
Ryan Klein comes back into the attack. He replaces Bas de Leede!

FOUR! Martin Guptill gets a hold of this one! Serves this short as well and outside off, Martin Guptill rocks this back and punch the ball towards deep cover for a boundary. Five singles and a four from this over!
Bowls this in line with the stumps and full, Glenn Phillips clips the ball wide of mid-wicket for another run.
Flights this one full outside off, Martin Guptill dabs this towards cover and takes a quick single.
This is short and in line with the stumps, Glenn Phillips flicks this through mid-wicket for a run.
Goes full this time and outside off, Martin Guptill uses his wrists and knocks the ball past the diving bowler to long on for a run.
Tim Pringle begins with a short delivery pitching on middle, Glenn Phillips goes back in the crease and thumps the ball towards long on for a single.
Slightly shorter, outside off. Glenn Phillips taps it towards point and takes a single. He retains the strike!

Angling in, a length delivery, around middle. Glenn Phillips tucks it gently towards long on and calls for two. There is a throw at the non-striker's end but well away from the stumps. Direct hit could have been curtains for Martin Guptill! Two taken!
Tighter line! Around the off pole, on a good length. Glenn Phillips dabs it towards point off the back foot.
Wide! Down the leg side this time, a length ball. Glenn Phillips misses his flick. Wide called!
Pulls his length back a tad, outside off. Glenn Phillips pushes it through cover. There is protection in the deep and so the batters will only get two runs.
Much fuller on this occasion, outside off. Glenn Phillips shows the full face of the bat and drives only to find a fielder at cover.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Martin Guptill rocks back and cuts it towards deep point for a single.
Bas de Leede is brought back into the attack!
Flighted delivery and on off, Martin Guptill eases it toward long off for a run.
Tossed up full and on off, Glenn Phillips drives it through covers for a single.

Good fielding in the deep there. This is short and outside off, Glenn Phillips stays back and crunches it wide of deep point. The fielder there runs to his left and dives to stop the ball and keeps it down to two.
Full and on middle and leg, Martin Guptill flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Glenn Phillips makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shariz Ahmad gets the dangerous Daryl Mitchell. This is floated on off, Daryl Mitchell skips down the track to heave it over deep mid-wicket but cannot get the timing right as he is through with his shot a bit too early. The ball goes high in the air and Max O'Dowd at deep mid-wicket takes a good catch diving to his right. Netherlands have been excellent in the field and they are getting the reward for it. New Zealand three down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Max O'Dowd b Shariz Ahmad

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up and on off, Martin Guptill steps out and makes it a full toss and chips it to long off on a bounce for a single.
Shariz Ahmad comes back to bowl. He went for 6 runs in his first over!
Fraction short this time and outside off, Martin Guptill slashes at this hard towards deep cover-point and takes a run.
This is on a good lengrth and outside off, Daryl Mitchell walks down the wicket and plays this with soft hands towards long on. Looks for two but has to settle for a run.
Ryan Klein bowls this in line with the stumps from a good length, Martin Guptill clips the ball towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Goes full this time and angles this in from outside off, Daryl Mitchell clips the ball towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Good timing from Daryl Mitchell! Ryan Klein serves this on a good length and outside off, Daryl Mitchell rocks back in his crease and punches this through point for a boundary. Good looking short from Daryl Mitchell.
Ryan Klein starts with a good-length delivery just outside off, Daryl Mitchell looks to pull but is not short enough and gets beaten on the under edge.
Shorter one again, outside off. Daryl Mitchell slashes this in the vacant cover-point region. Only a single!

This one skids off the surface, short in length again. Daryl Mitchell stays deep in his crease and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. A little fumble there by the fielder allows them to take two runs easily!
Drops it short again, around middle. Martin Guptill uses the depth of his crease and swipes this one towards deep square leg. Only a single.
Wide! Down the leg side, quicker one as well. Martin Guptill looks to pull this one but he fails to get any connection. Wide called!
Tosses this one up, very full, around off. Daryl Mitchell pushes it down to long on and rotates the strike!
Pitches it up now, around middle. Daryl Mitchell reverse-sweeps this one but finds the fielder at backward point.
Tim Pringle serves a shorter ball, around middle. Martin Guptill gets low and pulls this towards deep square leg for a single.
Tim Pringle is back on!
Goes fuller and on middle, Martin Guptill works this through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! This time he connects and finds the fence. This is a bit short and on off, Martin Guptill gets into position qucikly and pulls it hard towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
On a length and on middle and leg, Martin Guptill moves across to scoop it over short fine leg but cannot get a good connection at it and the ball goes of his gloves towards the keeper.
Sharp bouncer! This is banged short and on middle and leg, Martin Guptill ducks under it.
Length delivery and on off, Martin Guptill stands tall and pushes it to covers.
Bas de Leede starts with a short delivery around off, Daryl Mitchell tries to pull it but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg. They cross.
Bas de Leede is introduced into the attack!
Shariz Ahmad goes a fraction short this time and in line with the stumps, Daryl Mitchell hits this towards long on and takes a single to keep strike. Just 6 runs from the over.
Fires this one in full and on off, Daryl Mitchell whips this through mid-wicket and they take a couple of runs this time.
Shariz Ahmad flights this one full and on middle, Martin Guptill stays deep in the crease and clips the ball through mid-wicket for one run.
Serves this full outside off, Daryl Mitchell goes across the stumps and knocks this down to long on for a run.
Goes full once again and angling into the stumps, Daryl Mitchell reverse sweeps this straight to the short third man fielder.
Shariz Ahmad begins with a full delivery just outside off,  Martin Guptill clips this through mid-wicket and takes the first run quickly. There is no second on offer.
Wide of off this time, fuller one. Martin Guptill drives it down towards long off for a single. New Zealand are 33 for 2 at the end of the Powerplay!
Quicker, flatter, around off. Martin Guptill blocks it out off the back foot.

OUT! TAKEN! Clayton Floyd strikes and he gets rid of Dane Cleaver! Another big wicket for the Dutch! Dane Cleaver tries to be aggressive but he holes out this time. Slightly shorter, around middle. Dane Cleaver shimmies down the pitch and looks to hoick this one over mid-wicket. But the ball lobs up off his leading edge. Bas de Leede at extra cover takes an easy catch. Dane Cleaver walks back to the hut! Daryl Mitchell comes to the crease.
Commentary.Howout: c Bas de Leede b Clayton Floyd

Commentary.Commentary: Full now, around middle. Martin Guptill tucks it towards mid-wicket off the front foot for a single.
Shorter now, outside off. Martin Guptill stays in his crease and cuts it towards cover-point.

SIX! BANG! Martin Guptill is on the charge now! A fuller ball, around middle. Martin Guptill dances down the pitch and tonks it high over mid on all the way for a biggie! The ball has gone out of the park! New ball please...
On a length and on middle, Dane Cleaver gets behind it and blocks it out.
Risky single! This is on a length and on leg, Martin Guptill tucks it to short fine leg and calls for the run. The fielder there has a shy at the striker's end but misses and they get the run.
FOUR! SMASHED! This is full and outside off, Martin Guptill makes room and smashes this through covers for a boundary.
Pulls his length back a bit and outside off, Dane Cleaver cuts it hard but straight to cover-point. The fielder there lets it through and the batter gets a run.
Goes full this time and around leg, Dane Cleaver knocks it to mid on.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Martin Guptill stays back and chips it towards mid on for a single.
Logan van Beek is back on! He went for 3 runs in his first over!
Darts this one on middle and leg, Martin Guptill whips it past mid-wicket for a run.

FOUR! Martin Guptill gets his first boundary! Clayton Floyd serves this short and wide outside off, Martin Guptill goes back in the crease and cuts this to the left of the cover-point fielder. He puts in a dive but can not stop the ball as it runs away to the fence for four runs.
Clayton Floyd continues bowling full and in line with the stumps, Martin Guptill clips this towards mid-wicket.
Delivers this on a full length and just outside off, Dane Cleaver works this down to long on for a run.
Goes full once again outside off, Dane Cleaver knocks this towards mid off.
Clayton Floyd serves this full and angling in from outside off, Martin Guptill gets an inside edge uppishly towards deep square leg for a single.
Full in length, around middle. Dane Cleaver pushes it towards the fielder at mid on this time.
Slightly shorter, drifting in, around middle. Dane Cleaver drives it towards cover. No run there!
A fuller one, quicker, around middle. Dane Cleaver pushes it towards cover.
Dane Cleaver is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Netherlands draw first blood! Finn Allen has to depart. Tim Pringle flights this full outside off, Finn Allen takes a casual heave and mistimes the ball in the air towards the mid on fielder. Tom Cooper fumbles but eventually grabs on to it. Finn Allen makes the long walk back and New Zealand lose their first wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Tom Cooper b Tim Pringle

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! That brings up the first boundary for New Zealand! Tim Pringle flights this one full and in line with the stumps, Finn Allen shimmies down the wicket and lofts the ball over long on for a biggie. Finn Allen is on his way!
This is the arm ball, short and on off, skids thorugh, Finn Allen goes for the cut but misses it completely.

A huge appeal for LBW but turned down. This is a full delivery and on off, Finn Allen tries to smack it across the line but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but the finger stays down. The ball deflects of his pads and rolls to the off side. A leg bye taken.

Swing and a miss! This is on a hard length and around off, Finn Allen tries to pull it away towards mid-wicket but gets beaten as the ball kept a bit low. It looks that there is uneven bounce on this surface.

This has been a good start from Netherlands! They have managed to swing the ball around and have kept Martin Guptill and Finn Allen quiet for now! Too early to say that maybe, but these are positive signs for the Dutch!
Fullish delivery on middle, Finn Allen moves across and tucks it wide of deep mid-wicket for a comfortable brace.
Length delivery and on middle, Martin Guptill this time manages to tuck it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
This is on a length and on middle, Martin Guptill looks to work it to the leg side but gets hit on his pads.
BEATEN! Logan van Beek starts with a full delivery on leg, angling in, Martin Guptill makes room to play at it but gets beaten all ends up.
Logan van Beek will bowl from the other end.

Clayton Floyd pulls his length back slightly and angled the ball into middle. Finn Allen clips this towards mid-wicket for a dot to end the over. Just one run from the over and a good start for Netherlands!
Clayton Floyd flights this one full outside off, Finn Allen strokes this firmly towards cover.
Attempts the reverse-sweep once again, this is full and outside off, Finn Allen finds the backward point fielder this time.
This is full and in line with the stumps, Finn Allen goes for the reverse sweep straight to the point fielder.
Serves this a fraction short and spinning into the stumps, Finn Allen looks to play this leg side and gets a leading edge towards cover.
Clayton Floyd begins with a full delivery outside off, Martin Guptill strokes this past the diving bowler towards long off for a single.
We are all set for action! The players are out in the middle. Martin Guptill and Finn Allen will open the batting for New Zealand. Clayton Floyd will begin with the ball. Let's go!

Scott Edwards the captain of Netherlands says that it's going to be a good wicket, and should not change a lot. Says that Clayton Floyd comes in to play for this game. On Bas de Leede, he says that he played a massive role in the Qualifiers and he really helped them qualify for the World Cup.

Mitchell Santner the skipper of New Zealand says he wants to bat first as it looks like a very nice wicket. He says that it is a hybrid wicket but looks to good to bat on and they will be looking to put some runs on the board. He says that Michael Bracewell is rested for this game and they have gone with an extra pacer.

PITCH REPORT - Pieter Seelaar says its a hybrid wicket a very nice one and there is a nice cover of grass which can help the bowlers early on. It's an absolute belter and anything between 170-180 should be good on this pitch.
Netherlands (Playing XI) - Max O'Dowd, Stephan Myburgh, Bas de Leede, Tom Cooper, Scott Edwards(C/WK), Logan van Beek, Teja Nidamanuru, Clayton Floyd, Tim Pringle, Shariz Ahmad, Ryan Klein.
New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Finn Allen, Dane Cleaver (WK), Daryl Mitchell, Glenn Phillips, James Neesham, Mitchell Santner (C), Ish Sodhi, Lockie Ferguson, Ben Sears, Blair Tickner.
TOSS - New Zealand have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first.

Netherlands on the other hand are coming into this game after suffering a defeat in the World Cup T20 Qualifier final against Zimbabwe. However, before that final, they were unbeaten in all their group stage games and put on an outstanding show in the entire tournament. The Dutch have named a strong squad for this series against this brutal Kiwi side. All their experienced players are part of this team and they will have to be at their absolute best if they are to beat New Zealand. Which team will get over the line? We will find out. Stick around for the toss and other updates.
